title: Virtual Hydlide
overview: Killer trees, deadly dragons and blood-thirsty zombies are rife in this magical slash and hack adventure. To the haunting strains of the atmospheric soundtrack, explore the super-realistic 3D fantasy world, warping to different dimensions, collecting powerful weapons and mysterious objects and tackling weird and wonderful foes. The amazing landscape-generator creates a completely new adventure every time you play, providing a whole new dimension in RPG gaming.
